title.zh: 傳言：「地鐵隧道裡已經有部隊待命」
title.en: Rumor: 'Troops are already waiting inside the subway tunnels'

summary.zh: 這是遊戲虛構的夜間傳言，用來呈現在戒嚴宣布之初、公交停駛與通訊受阻時，街頭人群對部隊動向的種種猜測與緊繃情緒。現實中當時確有各種未經查證的街頭傳聞流傳，但此條對白本身為虛構設計，無單一史料依據。
summary.en: A fictional nighttime rumor illustrating the tension and speculation on the streets as martial law was declared and transit halted. While unverified rumors circulated widely in May 1989, this specific line is fictional.
